Two particles move along the \(x\)-axis. For \(0 \leq t \leq 8\), the position of particle \(P\) at time \(t\) is given by
\(x_{P}(t)=\ln \left(t^{2}-2 t+10\right)\), while the velocity of particle \(Q\) at time \(t\) is given by \(v_{Q}(t)=t^{2}-8 t+15\).
Particle \(Q\) is at position \(x=5\) at time \(t=0\).
(a) For \(0 \leq t \leq 8\), when is particle \(P\) moving to the left?
(b) For \(0 \leq t \leq 8\), find all times \(t\) during which the two particles travel in the same direction.
(c) Find the acceleration of particle \(Q\) at time \(t=2\). Is the speed of particle \(Q\) increasing, decreasing, or
neither at time \(t=2\) ? Explain your reasoning.
(d) Find the position of particle \(Q\) the first time it changes direction.
rawScoringGuide:
\section*{Question 5}
\begin{itemize}
\item[(a)] \(x_{P}^{\prime}(t)=\frac{2 t-2}{t^{2}-2 t+10}=\frac{2(t-1)}{t^{2}-2 t+10}\)
\(t^{2}-2 t+10>0\) for all \(t\).
\(x_{P}^{\prime}(t)=0 \Rightarrow t=1\)
\(x_{P}^{\prime}(t)<0\) for \(0 \leq t<1\).
Therefore, the particle is moving to the left for \(0 \leq t<1\).
\item[(b)] \(v_{Q}(t)=(t-5)(t-3)\)
\(v_{Q}(t)=0 \Rightarrow t=3, t=5\)
![](https://cdn.mathpix.com/cropped/9fe1f645-3770-4eda-9aa7-7d875959b6d6-1.jpg?height=367&width=917&top_left_y=1154&top_left_x=256)
Both particles move in the same direction for \(1<t<3\) and \(5<t \leq 8\) since \(v_{P}(t)=x_{P}^{\prime}(t)\) and \(v_{Q}(t)\) have the same sign on these intervals.
\item[(c)] \(a_{Q}(t)=v_{Q}^{\prime}(t)=2 t-8\)
\(a_{Q}(2)=2 \cdot 2-8=-4\)
\(a_{Q}(2)<0\) and \(v_{Q}(2)=3>0\)
At time \(t=2\), the speed of the particle is decreasing because velocity and acceleration have opposite signs.
\item[(d)] Particle \(Q\) first changes direction at time \(t=3\).
\[
\begin{aligned}
x_{Q}(3) & =x_{Q}(0)+\int_{0}^{3} v_{Q}(t) d t=5+\int_{0}^{3}\left(t^{2}-8 t+15\right) d t \\
& =5+\left[\frac{1}{3} t^{3}-4 t^{2}+15 t\right]_{t=0}^{t=3}=5+(9-36+45)=23
\end{aligned}
\]
\item[2] : \(\left\{\begin{array}{l}1: x_{P}^{\prime}(t) \\ 1: \text { interval }\end{array}\right.\)
\item[2] : \(\left\{\begin{array}{l}1 \text { : intervals } \\ 1 \text { : analysis using } v_{P}(t) \text { and } v_{Q}(t)\end{array}\right.\)
\item[] Note: 1/2 if only one interval with analysis
\item[] Note: \(0 / 2\) if no analysis
\item[] \(2:\left\{\begin{array}{l}1: a_{Q}(2) \\ 1: \text { speed decreasing with reason }\end{array}\right.\)
\item[] \(3:\left\{\begin{array}{l}1: \text { antiderivative } \\ 1: \text { uses initial condition } \\ 1: \text { answer }\end{array}\right.\)
\end{itemize}
